$comment: Recado para Bruno (internal doc, not included in the template). Herramienta webhook nueva del agente de voz V7.

tools.name: booking_recado_para_owner
tools.description: Leave a message for Bruno, the owner, who gets it on his phone. Use it ONLY as RECADO PARA BRUNO says: the customer wants to speak to Bruno or a person, will arrive late, complains, or asks something that is not booking, checking, cancelling or changing an appointment. One per call. Read the answer's message word for word.

conversation_id.description: Bind to the system__conversation_id dynamic variable.

caller_phone.description: Bind to the system__caller_id dynamic variable. Never filled by the LLM.

kind.description: late: will arrive late. wants_human: wants to speak to Bruno or a person. complaint: a complaint. question: anything else that is not an appointment.

summary.description: In Spanish, what the customer wants Bruno to know, in their own words, one or two sentences. Never invent it.

minutes_late.description: kind late only, and only if the customer said how many minutes.

customer_name.description: The customer's name if they said it in this call. Never invent it.

dictated_phone.description: Only after phone_needed or dictated_invalid: the phone the customer dictated, digits only.

outcomes.phone_needed: read message (it is a question), wait, call again with dictated_phone and customer_name
outcomes.dictated_invalid: read message (it is a question), wait, call again with dictated_phone
